def transform(grid):

      vals={g[r][c] for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1)}

       fill=2 if x==6 else 7
       for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1): g[r][c]=fill
 return g
PY
